Both files pass the Strata audit clean (score 100, no findings).

**Summary of the build** (`src/screens/Screen.tsx` + `src/screens/Screen.module.css`):

- Seven mock members (an owner, two admins, four members) with name, email, role and last-active timestamps, rendered in a `DataTable` (avatar + name as row header, email, role `Badge`, relative "last active" text, and a row actions menu).
- Each non-owner row has a `MenuTrigger` → `Menu` with "Make admin"/"Make member" (toggles based on current role) and a danger "Remove from team" item; the owner row has no actions, protecting the sole owner.
- Removal opens a controlled `AlertDialog` (destructive-action confirmation) naming the person before removing them from state.
- "Invite" is a `DialogTrigger` → `Dialog` with an email `TextField` and a role `Select` (Admin/Member); submitting adds a new member with no last-active date ("Never — invited").
- All colours/spacing/typography use `var(--strata-*)` tokens, logical properties only, and every icon-only control has an `aria-label`.

I can't run the app to verify interactively, so this hasn't been visually tested in a browser — only checked against the Strata auditor and component docs.
